page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically the Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance away from heavy storage-I/O or parallel-processing workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer a predictable resource density for standard enterprise applications. This hardware profile is appropriate for workloads such as web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business applications that require consistent CPU performance without the need for high-speed local disk access or hardware acceleration.
